tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen. Comes from the user's app colour: the colour mixed 86 % toward white (white theme: #f7f5f0). Text tokens text, text-secondary, text-muted, text-subtle and ink all read on it in every theme.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: the home fridge card, selected segmented-control track, chips that show a count or time, avatar circles, the «i» hint button, stepper buttons, the selected option in a choice group. The colour mixed 60 % toward white. text and ink read on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Theme-tinted hairlines: progress-bar tracks in onboarding, chip outlines in AI Chef, the chat input border, bottom-nav top border. Decorative only: never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, send button, active list tab, checked checkbox and switch, progress fills, the user's own chat bubble, the selected-option border. The app colour darkened until white text on it reaches 4.8:1. Put on-accent text on it, never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Tinted text for links and active states on bg, surface and soft: «Усі», «Змінити», «Списати», active bottom-nav label, «у нормі» status words. accent darkened 30 %.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (buttons, user chat bubble, active list tab). At least 4.8:1 in every theme by construction.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, inputs, secondary buttons, round icon buttons, bottom nav, bottom sheets, AI Chef replies. Sits on bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, product names, body copy, input values. On bg, soft, surface in every theme.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting sentences and section labels («Функції — вмикайте, що потрібно», «Треба купити · 3»). On bg, soft, surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines under rows (category, quantity, «1 порція · 15 хв»), inactive tab labels, crossed-out bought items. On bg, soft, surface.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Hints and fine print: inactive bottom-nav labels, dividers' «або вручну», resend timers, legal line on login. On bg and surface; 4.5:1 or better in every theme.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: 1 px border of text inputs, selects, secondary buttons and unselected choice buttons on surface or bg. From the design; it is lighter than the 3:1 control-border guideline, so every input also has a visible label and white fill against bg.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: 1 px lines between rows inside a list group and between table rows. Decorative.

tokens.name: neutral-tile
tokens.usage: Neutral fills: «ok» expiry badge, icon tiles beside list cards, inactive segmented track in water settings.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar background (#efebe3).

tokens.name: toggle-off
tokens.usage: Switch track when off.

tokens.name: sheet-handle
tokens.usage: Grab handle at the top of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: dashed
tokens.usage: 1 px dashed outline of the «+ Новий» list tab: an action that creates something new.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind bottom sheets and desktop dialogs.

tokens.name: tooltip
tokens.usage: Dark popover of the «i» measurement hint («5 г цукру ≈ 1 чайна ложка»); on-accent text on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive text actions only: «Вийти», «Видалити», delete icons. Text on surface or bg; never a filled button.

tokens.name: status-urgent-fg

tokens.name: status-soon-bg

tokens.name: status-soon-fg

tokens.name: warning-text

tokens.name: status-ok-bg

tokens.name: status-ok-fg

tokens.name: macro-low
